presets.name: Sepia
presets.description: The eyes are not painted, they take whichever of two inks holds up against the body. Move the bodies into brown and the eyes follow on their own.

presets.name: Greyscale
presets.description: Nothing here but a silhouette and a pair of eyes, so losing color costs the style very little. Useful for a print stylesheet or a chart where color already means something.

presets.name: Duotone
presets.description: A single body color across a whole set, so the silhouette, the eyes and how far apart they sit are all that separates two avatars.

presets.name: Muted
presets.summary: Dusty bodies instead of the pastels.
presets.description: The shipped palette is six bright pastels. These are the same bodies in tones that hold still, which suits a sidebar where a dozen appear at once.

presets.name: Electric
presets.summary: Bodies past anything the style ships.
presets.description: The same lever the other way, on a near black ground. The ink flips to the dark of the two by itself, because the neon bodies are the lighter side of every pairing.

presets.name: Pastel Wall
presets.description: Gaze ships no background of its own and renders transparent. A pale ground gives the shape an edge to sit against without touching the artwork.

presets.name: Bold Pop
presets.description: Louder than Pastel Wall. The bodies are pale, so they keep their edge on top of it.

presets.name: Night Shift
presets.description: For dark interfaces. The shipped bodies are pastel already, so nothing else has to move for the shape to stay visible.

presets.name: Sunrise
presets.summary: A warm gradient behind the body.
presets.description: Shows the gradient background options: two colors, a linear fill and a fixed angle. The seed still decides which of the two ends up on top.

presets.name: Geometric
presets.description: Seven of the eleven shapes are plain polygons and the other four are drawn by hand. Keeping the polygons gives a set one consistent edge treatment, which reads more like a system of icons than a family of creatures.

presets.name: Animated
presets.summary: Turns the style's built-in animation on.
presets.description: The style ships an animation component that is off by default. The `animation` tag switches it on and lets the seed pick a speed, so the eyes wander and blink while the body hops. It respects prefers-reduced-motion.

presets.name: Close Up
presets.summary: Scaled in, so the body runs past the edge.
presets.description: Uses scale rather than color. Cropping in leaves the eyes and little else, which reads better at the size a comment thread gives an avatar.
